svg.text: q = weight_count; B = NUM_BATCHES; lane L is an elaboration index.
acc_clear loads bias; count_en advances q; acc_en permits a MAC.
capture_valid is internal, one cycle per completed batch.
else if count_en AND q < N_IN+1:
All lanes receive the same address
else if capture_valid AND batch < B−1:
Hold the last batch; never address B.
Do not clear batch on acc_clear.
Contiguous neuron n = L × B + batch
One combinational owner for the next-value array
weights_done [1] → next-state logic; batches_done [1] → next-state logic.
busy [1], done [1] → FC-layer ports. acc_out array → top datapath.
Counters update at the closing edge; capture uses the current batch.
CLEAR resets q and loads the current bias. FILL_0/FILL_1 advance q.
The final MAC commits at ACCUMULATE → CAPTURE.
CAPTURE writes the stable sum one edge later, then advances batch.
Contiguous ownership: neuron = lane × B + batch • B = ceil(N_OUT / LANES)
